instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Precision metal fabrication shop specializing in CNC-machined aluminum and titanium components for aerospace and automotive Tier-1 suppliers. We run 12 CNC machining centers across two shifts, focusing heavily on complex tolerances for high-performance parts. Our operations are currently centered around rapid prototyping and custom tooling development.
answers.pastInitiatives: A junior engineer built an internal dashboard to visualize our order backlog, which the operations team found useful but lacked official support or maintenance. This initiative highlighted a critical need for process standardization and institutional knowledge retention in technical assets.
answers.strategicGoals: Our primary objective is to reduce operating expenses by 15% over the next 2 years while maintaining current output levels. We believe there is significant waste in our manual processes and want to identify the highest-ROI automation opportunities across order processing, invoicing, and customer support workflows. We are not looking to grow headcount — we want to do more with our existing team.
answers.additionalContext: The company relies heavily on a few long-term contracts with major OEMs, making stability crucial. Current efficiency gains are directly tied to minimizing scrap rates and improving cycle times for critical components.
answers.teamSize: The founder handles all product and technology decisions personally with occasional input from a part-time freelance developer. There is no formal engineering team — technical work is either done by the founder or outsourced to contractors on a project basis. Innovation bandwidth is essentially limited to whatever the founder can personally drive alongside day-to-day operations.

opportunities.title: Lean Tooling Optimization & Simulation Integration
opportunities.rationale: Implementing standardized tooling and integrating basic simulation software into the design phase can reduce scrap rate by an estimated 8-12%. This aligns directly with the efficiency goal and utilizes existing CAD capabilities.

first_actions: Audit current toolset for obsolescence and standardization opportunities.
Invest in a basic FEA/simulation module subscription for key components.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduce material scrap rate by 10% within 6 months
milestones: Q1: Complete tooling audit and standardized process documentation.
Q2: Integrate simulation into 3 key product designs.

opportunities.title: Automated Quote & Order Workflow Integration
opportunities.rationale: Developing a lightweight internal tool to automate the conversion of customer specifications into preliminary quotes and work orders will drastically reduce manual administrative overhead, improving short-term efficiency.

first_actions: Define data requirements for quote generation module.
Select no-code platform (e.g., Airtable or custom script) for rapid development.
resources_needed: Estimated $1k for basic platform setup and testing
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduce order processing time from 4 days to 2 days.
milestones: Month 3: Internal pilot of the automated quoting system.

opportunities.title: Pilot AI-Driven Predictive Maintenance for CNC Machines
opportunities.rationale: Deploying a low-cost sensor network combined with machine learning models can predict tool wear and equipment failure, moving beyond reactive maintenance. This could significantly reduce unplanned downtime and lower long-term operational costs.

first_actions: Identify 5 key CNC machines for sensor integration pilot.
Engage external consultant (part-time) to build initial ML model.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduce unscheduled machine downtime by 25% in the pilot group.
milestones: Q1: Sensor installation and data pipeline setup.
Q4: Full predictive model validation and deployment on 3 machines.

next_steps.action: Conduct a full process mapping review across order-to-delivery lifecycle.
Formalize the budget for the Lean Tooling Optimization pilot and secure necessary software licenses.
Identify a potential part-time external data science advisor to support the predictive maintenance exploration.

key_weaknesses: Lack of formal documentation and institutional knowledge transfer, making processes fragile when key personnel leave.
Low digital maturity preventing the leveraging of existing data for predictive analytics or automated workflows.
Founder dependency on technical expertise limits innovation bandwidth and creates high risk if they are unavailable.
Informal decision-making process lacks rigor, which can lead to sub-optimal long-term strategic choices.
